record.one_liner: Pinterest: visual discovery platform with a v5 REST API covering pins, boards, ads, catalogs and analytics.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant (and client credentials grant) against the v5 token endpoint. The token request itself uses HTTP Basic with client_id:client_secret. Trial-access apps can also generate a product-limited test token from the app dashboard, which expires after 24 hours.
record.access_notes: Developers create an app in My apps, then submit a request form for Trial access. Pinterest reviews each request by email. Standard access is a further upgrade for production use. critic: re-derived, access approval_required confirmed (no free credentials without approval).
record.api_notes: REST endpoints under https://api.pinterest.com/v5/. Trial access covers reading and writing across ads, boards, pins, catalogs and analytics; Standard access raises rate limits.
record.blocker_notes: Even Trial access needs Pinterest to approve the app request before any credentials work. The vendor MCP page (pinterest/mcp-server) still says 'Be the first to know when it launches.', so it may not be generally available yet. critic: mcp official kept, vendor-owned page and pinterest/mcp-server repo reference.
